text:
elaine: quick check 1 dense creds row mock ready. thinking: Rotate visible, Revoke inside kebab. Need a11y + undo flow review. https://img.redwood/mock/row-dense-v1.png

sasha: +1 on kebab for revoke. UX nits: keep touch targets >=44px and bump row min-height slightly. empty state should center the Create CTA.

kevin: a11y: toasts use aria-live="polite". For clipboard success say "Secret copied" (polite). For errors use assertive SR-only node. Revoke modal = role="alertdialog" and trap focus.

ops-kate: ops: default undo window = 30s (ok). Make it org-configurable up to 60s. Backend marks keys disabled immediately; UI shows undo toast.

elaine: decision: 30s default undo, Revoke -> kebab, concise toasts, increase row height. I'll update mocks and post in #design. :white_check_mark:
